fixtures.description: A Task document missing the required `outputs` field.
A document whose exact bytes do not match its claimed digest (claimed-digest.json != sha256 of document.json).
An attempt-started observation sequenced after the authoritative attempt-terminal — terminal states are absorbing (§10.4 rule 1).
fixtures.expectedDisposition: derived state remains the terminal state; the late observation has no effect

fixtures.description: A duplicated (source,id) observation plus array order that contradicts sequence order.
fixtures.expectedDisposition: dedupes on (source,id); resolves order by sequence, not array position

fixtures.description: Two `sequence` values straddling a decimal-width rollover (9 -> 10), pinning that the fixed 16-digit zero-padded encoding orders lexicographically the same as numerically.
Two attempt-terminal observations (delivered, then failed) — not the sanctioned lost-correction case.
fixtures.expectedDisposition: derived state = the first terminal in sequence order (delivered), contradictory: true

fixtures.description: log-without-terminal.json folded with fold-options.json derives provisional `expired`; log-with-terminal.json (the same Attempt, extended with a genuine attempt-terminal{delivered}) derives `delivered` with no `contradictory` flag.
fixtures.expectedDisposition: provisional expired is superseded by a genuine terminal, never itself a log entry

fixtures.description: attempt-terminal{lost}, later corrected by attempt-terminal{delivered} once the partition heals (§10.4 rule 6).
delivery-b-forged-supersedes.json names delivery-a.json's digest in `supersedes`, but the two Deliveries belong to different Attempts.
fixtures.expectedDisposition: invalid-document (checkable whenever both records are held, §11.3 rule 1)

fixtures.description: submission-a and submission-b share (requester, idempotencyKey) but differ in bytes; submission-c reuses the literal key string under a different requester.
fixtures.expectedDisposition: a/b: submission-conflict (same scope, different bytes); a/c: distinct scopes, no conflict (§12.2)

fixtures.description: A structurally valid DispatchContext document that was never genuinely conveyed at dispatch.
fixtures.expectedDisposition: NOT caught by structure alone; the Layer-3 dispatch-binding check is the intended catch (§24)

fixtures.description: A confidential-input Task resubmitted by an unauthorized requester, with no capabilityGrants.
fixtures.expectedDisposition: structural fact only (no grants present); resolution-failure enforcement is Layer 3 (§24)

fixtures.description: A namespaced extension field claiming a different `protocol` than the document's core field.
fixtures.expectedDisposition: invalid-document where a validator can detect the contradiction (§21.3)

fixtures.description: A ResourceDescriptor with inline `content` over 64 KiB, and an observation `message` over 4 KiB.
fixtures.expectedDisposition: the observation message IS rejected (schema-enforced MUST, §10.2); the inline content is NOT rejected -- its 64 KiB ceiling is a documented un-enforced SHOULD (§6.4/§20, Layer-3 boundary)
